name: starlight-communities
description: Build creation-cell communities and prepare host programme feasibility with explicit human review.

interface.shortDescription: Design and run agentic creation cells.
interface.longDescription: Starlight Communities helps Codex design, evaluate, and operate high-trust weekly creation cells with bounded agents, human gates, memory rules, and deployable local or Railway architecture. Includes local host programme capacity, economics, responsibility and media-review planning; no booking or payment execution.
defaultPrompt: Draft a weekly cell run sheet.
Assess a host programme plan before committing dates or money.
